'''Moahdi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] from [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. He was part of a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Task force/Legends|task force]] led by [[Wehutti]]. The other members of the task force were [[Herut]] and [[Kejas]]. While waiting for emissaries from the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] to arrive, Moahdi and the task force attacked [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], mistaking them for [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] enemies instead of their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] contacts.
